name: @jinba1/mthc-darwin-arm64
description: macOS arm64 native binary for mthc.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const { accessSync, constants, statSync } = require('node:fs'); if (!statSync('bin/mthc').isFile()) throw new Error('bin/mthc must be a regular file'); accessSync('bin/mthc', constants.X_OK)"
